description: Works without a Remoet account. Get detailed information about a specific company listing by its slug. Use this to review a company before deciding whether to star it. Returns the company's full description, perks, job count, and URLs. hiringStats shows how often the company opens roles and how long roles stay listed, counted in distinct roles: newRoles30d/newRoles90d (roles posted in the window, by the board's own publish date where it gives one, else when Remoet first saw the role), closedRoles90d (roles taken down), and medianDaysListed (median days from posting to takedown, over medianSampleSize roles closed in the last 180 days). A takedown is not a confirmed hire, so report how long roles stay listed, never a time to hire. A null count means Remoet cannot answer it honestly: tracking began inside the window (see trackedSince), or most of the board came down at once (a dead board or broken source) so the closed count is unknown. A null median means fewer than 5 closed roles or under 180 days of tracking. salaryStats gives pay bands over the company's live roles on the public board that state a salary (rolesWithSalary; it can be lower than jobCount, which also counts roles Remoet does not publish): bands[] has label 'all' plus 'junior'/'mid'/'senior' where at least 5 roles back it, each with medianFrom, medianTo, p25From, p75To and sampleSize. medianTo and p75To are null when fewer than 5 of those roles state an upper figure: there is no honest top to quote, not missing data. Figures are stated salaries converted to USD a year, not salaries posted in USD; say so when quoting them. NOTE: the tech stack is a small preview unless the company is starred. Starring unlocks the full stack (techStackCount shows the true total, e.g. a 3-tag preview of 147). Pass checkTechStack with the user's technologies to verify overlap against the FULL stack. Matched ones come back in matchedTechStack and lead the preview, same contract as search_listings. The star budget is reported by get_account.

checkTechStack.description: Technologies to verify against the company's full stack (auto-normalized, max 50); matches are returned in matchedTechStack

slug.description: The URL slug of the listing (e.g. "digital-ocean", "stripe")
